# Taskly

> Taskly is an Angular SSR task management application for teams that lets you organize projects, tasks, and collaboration in one place.

## Overview

Taskly allows teams to create projects, organize tasks with a Kanban board, invite members via email, manage epics, and collaborate efficiently.

## Docs

- [Home](https://taskly-99u5.vercel.app/): Main landing page and app overview
- [Login](https://taskly-99u5.vercel.app/login): User authentication and sign-in page

## Features

- Authentication
- Project Management
- Kanban Board
- Task CRUD
- Epic Management
- Member Invitations
- Email Verification
- SEO Optimization

## Technologies

- Angular
- Angular CSR
- TypeScript
- RxJS
- Tailwind CSS
- Supabase
